name: WoWToolsForever
author: Karlo
Domekologe
description: FOREVER version of WoWTools. Cog for interacting with the World of Warcraft: Forever APIs (Blizzard, realmless: characters are looked up by region + first name + surname, guilds by region + guild name). Loads alongside the retail (wowt-) and classic (wowtc-) WoWTools cogs; all commands are prefixed with wowtf-. Features without WoW Forever support (Raider.IO, Mythic+ scoreboard, PvP ratings) answer with a notice instead.
short: FOREVER version of WoWTools for World of Warcraft: Forever.
install_msg:
Make sure you check out `[p]help wowtf-serverset` and `[p]help wowtf-wowset` after loading this cog and set your region (and guild) as some commands won't work otherwise.

This cog queries the Blizzard API (WoW Forever namespaces) and needs Blizzard API credentials: `[p]set api blizzard client_id,<id> client_secret,<secret>`.
Note: WoW Forever characters only appear in the API from level 10 and after logging out.
end_user_data_statement: This cog can store the first name, surname and region of a Discord user's World of Warcraft: Forever character. This data is used to fetch information about the character from the Blizzard API.
